svg.aria-label: ConvFinQA deploy topology: a visitor with no login reaches a single App Runner instance of 0.5 vCPU and 1 GB, which serves the dataset, the committed prediction CSVs and the recorded demo pack baked into its own image; GitHub Actions pushes that image to ECR over OIDC and App Runner auto-deploys the latest tag, while one CloudWatch alarm watches for sustained 5xx. There is no VPC and no database.

g.title: GitHub Actions — merge to main, CI must conclude success, then OIDC into the deploy role; no AWS keys are stored anywhere
ECR — the image registry; pushing :latest is the release step, App Runner auto-deploys it, and the lifecycle policy keeps five images as the rollback window
CloudWatch — one alarm, on sustained 5xx from the service: the single failure mode worth being paged about
visitor — no login, no account, nothing to sign up for
App Runner — one service, one instance, 0.5 vCPU and 1 GB sized from measured RSS; --workers 1, sessions and rate limits in process memory
state, all of it baked into the image at build time — the dataset, the committed prediction CSVs, the s7 diagnostics, the exported registry and the recorded demo pack

path.title: the service publishes its 5xx count to the alarm

svg.text: ap-southeast-1 · Terraform · no VPC · no DB
